pages.text: Long ago, people loved to play games and test their strength.
In ancient Greece, athletes gathered for the Olympic Games.
The first Olympics began over two thousand years ago.
Running races were among the earliest Olympic events.
Wrestling and discus throwing tested skill and strength.
Winners were crowned with olive wreaths instead of medals.
Sports were not only about winning. They taught fairness and respect.
Over time, games spread across many cultures and countries.
Today, the modern Olympics bring athletes together from around the world.
Ancient games remind us that teamwork and fair play matter most.
